name: BSManager
description: Lists the Beat Saber instances managed by BSManager, one game per instance, and opens BSManager from the Open launcher menu.
author: Questkeep

folders.label: BSManager instances folder
folders.hint: The folder that contains your Beat Saber instances (BSManager's BSInstances folder).

folders.label: BSManager program folder
folders.hint: The folder with BSManager.exe (BSManager's install folder). The default is where BSManager installs itself.
